name: toast
title: Toast
description: Toasts that grow out of the point you clicked and fold into a stack. Hover or focus unfolds the stack and pauses the timers, a polite live region reads each one, Alt+T jumps to the newest.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Toast from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Toaster, useToast } from "@/components/ui/motion-toast".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-toast.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createToaster on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/toast/toast.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#toast
